description: Convert a SATO SBPL, Honeywell (Datamax) DPL or Honeywell (Intermec) IPL label stream to ZPL, so it can be checked with zpl_validate and rendered with zpl_preview. You must name the source language: language_detect does not recognise these three. Real control characters and the manuals' readable notation (<STX>, <ESC>) are both accepted. Commands outside the supported subset (printer settings, RFID, job management, some 2D symbologies) are skipped with a warning, never silently: non-empty `warnings` mean the conversion is not 1:1 and `one_to_one` is false — show the warnings to the user. The output follows each manufacturer's command reference and is not verified on physical printers; check a preview and a test print before production.

code.description: Raw SBPL, DPL or IPL label stream

dpmm.description: Target printer density in dots per mm (8 = 203 dpi)

label_length_mm.description: DPL only: label length in mm. DPL measures rows from the bottom edge, ZPL from the top; without it (or <STX>c in the stream) 6 inches is assumed and a warning is added.

source_language.description: Language of `code`: sbpl (SATO), dpl (Datamax / Honeywell) or ipl (Intermec / Honeywell)

name: printer_language_to_zpl

one_to_one.description: True only when warnings is empty

warnings.description: Everything not carried over, with the manual page

zpl.description: Converted ZPL, one ^XA...^XZ block per label

title: Convert printer language to ZPL
